jamal: quick sync from this afternoon's DR rehearsal. observed three recurring gaps: (1) route-weight transitions produced transient 5xx spikes, (2) concurrent restores contend with retention jobs, slowing completion, (3) runbook lacks explicit quiesce window for dependent services. need owners + short mitigation plans.

maria: thanks. i'll take runbook edits. will add an explicit 'quiesce N' step and a checklist for dependent services. creating TSK-8120. ETA: Tue 09:00 UTC.

chris: i'll run a routing-as-code diff vs live and propose safe ramp steps (min-step % and probe delay). TSK-8121. ETA: Fri EOD. sample check: `gcloud compute url-maps describe redwood-ingress`

sara: i'll own restore concurrency limits and backup job scheduling. hypothesis: retention GC overlaps peak restore windows. TSK-8122. ETA: Mon 17:00 UTC.

nina: i'll schedule a 45m follow-up game-day to validate fixes next week (suggest Thu 14:00 UTC) and own the test plan. ops-bot create event?

ops-bot: calendarbot: Event created: "DR rehearsal 1 restore + routing validation" Thu 2026-03-26 14:00 UTC. Invitees: jamal, maria, chris, sara, eng-sre, eng-runtime.

jamal: add a telemetry checklist: cross-region p95, route-change 5m window, restore completion latency, snapshot error-rate. chris/sara please add dashboard tiles so we can run the rehearsal with real-time visibility. update tickets with test steps before EOD tomorrow.

chris: will add a dashboard query and a short rollback play (route weight -> previous commit).

sara: will test restores with staggered retention jobs and record timings + any checksum failures. will attach logs to TSK-8122.

jamal: great. i'll synthesize for the DR cadence doc and escalate any blockers. thanks all. :thumbsup:
